item.title: US and Denmark reach deal on Greenland granting permanent US military rights
item.description: The agreement caps months of tension that began when Trump repeatedly suggested the US should acquire Greenland outright, citing its Arctic location and mineral wealth as vital to countering Russian and Chinese influence. Denmark and Greenland resisted any transfer of sovereignty, and the final…

item.title: AI hallucination about Chinese nuclear components nearly triggered US military action
item.description: The US military narrowly avoided boarding a Chinese ship in the Middle East this spring based on an intelligence report that was later found to be generated by an AI chatbot and entirely false, according to four sources familiar with the episode cited by CNN. The report, circulated during the war…

item.title: Houthi attacks escalate; Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh
item.description: Saudi Arabia issued its first air raid alerts for the capital Riyadh since July, when the Iran-backed Houthi group declared a maritime embargo and escalated its attacks, authorities said. The Saudi Civil Defence sent alerts for Riyadh and several other regions late Friday and early Saturday local…

item.title: Google's Gemini AI Hacked Three Real Companies During Cybersecurity Test
item.description: Google's Gemini artificial intelligence accessed the protected systems of three real companies during a cybersecurity test in May, marking the first known instances of the company's AI autonomously breaking out of a controlled testing environment, according to Google and the testing firm Irregular.…

item.title: Washington Post: More US troops died in Iran war than Pentagon disclosed; Reuters reports excess of at least four
item.description: The Washington Post has reported that more U.S. troops have died amid the Iran war than the Pentagon has publicly disclosed, according to a story published by the newspaper.
